- Education on chronic disease prevention and lifestyle modification:

  - Advised to increase use of reliever inhaler; instructed to use inhaler more regularly initially (suggested 2–4 puffs every 4 hours) — plan to monitor response.
  - Advised use of a spacer to improve inhaler technique; pharmacist to demonstrate spacer and peak flow meter use.
  - Advised to start a regular oral antihistamine for hay fever (patient advised to obtain from pharmacy; doctor to place note about what to take).

  - Primary care review arranged (~1 week) to reassess asthma control and consider starting controller inhaler if required.
  - No other referrals documented.

- Schedule follow-up and recall appointments as needed:
